extra.reason: Verified with a scratch jsdom harness (18 checks, 0 failures) against R-rendered collapse markup: bsides.collapse registered, find() locates both panels, getValue closed/open, getState wraps it, open/close/toggle dispatch, open-on-open and close-on-closed report nothing, unknown and absent method leave state untouched and silent, Collapse.getInstance(el) null after unsubscribe, unsubscribe of a never-messaged panel constructs no instance. npm run build passes check-types, check-format, check-lint, js-compile. Permanent harness coverage is yonder-4tv.3.

Verified with a scratch jsdom harness (12 checks, 0 failures): triggersFor() resolves data-bs-target and href, skips a non-selector href without throwing; syncTriggers() runs from initialize() and both shown/hidden handlers. Confirmed the state='open' trigger is corrected at bind (collapse_panel_button() hardcodes aria-expanded='false'), two buttons plus an anchor on one panel all update on server-driven open/close/toggle, a trigger appended after bind reflects the next state change, and another panel's trigger is untouched. npm run js passes check-types, check-format, check-lint. Permanent harness coverage is yonder-4tv.3.

Added collapse and collapse-open fixtures to gen-html.R (panel + collapse_panel_button trigger, closed and state='open') and a 29-check collapse block to test-bindings.mjs. npm run build && npm run test-dom: 470 checks, 0 failures. A negative control (flipping one assertion) confirmed the block executes rather than being skipped. Scenarios covered: initial value both states, getState, value after user click open and close, all three methods, both idempotence cases, unrecognized and absent method, trigger sync at bind including the state='open' correction, sync after server-driven open/close, two buttons plus an href anchor on one panel, an invalid-href anchor left alone and not throwing, a trigger added after bind, unsubscribe disposing the instance and silencing the panel, and re-render with the same id. The mid-transition scenario is left uncovered with a comment recording why: jsdom reports no transition duration, so shown/hidden fire synchronously and the test would pass vacuously.

Added tests/testthat/test-collapse.R. Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "collapse")': 35 pass, 0 fail, 0 warn, 0 skip. Covers collapse_panel() and collapse_panel_button() id/target validation, state and direction arg matching, rendered markup (class="bsides-collapse collapse", show for state='open', collapse-horizontal, data-bs-toggle/data-bs-target/aria-controls on the button, ... as content), and the list(method=...) each of open_/close_/toggle_collapse_panel() sends through the recording_session() helper. R/collapse.R unchanged.
